base_selection: Best matching first-parent revision; 309 revisions compared
review: Aurora merged Horizon main of 2026-11-10 (0300ba0) on top of the 2026-11-09 merge. Upstream moved remote packet polling to game/remote_poll.rs (Aurora's bounded Android chunk budget carried there), the Horizon settings page to options_ui_pages.rs (Aurora's Horizon Boost row added), the swapchain configuration to gfx/output_apply.rs (Aurora's full-window Android presentation size added), and Studio's fields into game.studio. Upstream removed offline names from its desktop launcher; Aurora keeps its own offline, Microsoft and Ely.by accounts in its Android launcher, and account.rs keeps provider-qualified keys. Kept for Android: touch and keypad input, the launcher's mod browser and installed list, skins.rs for the wardrobe. cargo check passed on arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64 with the source checks; device testing of this merge is pending.

accounts_appearance_review.notes: Reviewed newer account-save reporting and desktop encrypted-file storage changes. Android retains its Keystore AES/GCM store and reports sign-in save failures through the existing shared task. The selected stable nightly baseline is unchanged; no experimental UI branches were merged.

android_stability_review.notes: Reviewed the current upstream loading handoff: it still leaks its resource owner for the process lifetime and has no Android lifecycle or GLES preparation path to transplant. Retained the Android baseline; this change owns resources per session, publishes background pause without redraws, and keeps native events flowing during exclusive GLES world preparation. No upstream deployment workflows were enabled.
